correctness.rationale: The explicit H is constructed over F5 and verified rank six. Erasure ambiguity equals nullity of H_E; all 792 five- and 924 six-subsets are exactly rank-tested by modular elimination. A separate enumeration of all \(5^6\) codewords agrees with 16 five-supports, 69 minimal six-supports and the full weight distribution; an independent geometric incidence tally yields 16 five-circuits. The manifest lists every one of the 85 circuits; pairwise 5-circuit intersection <=3 ensures 112 distinct six-extensions. All 181 failures have rank deficiency one. The statement is strictly finite and has no extrapolated or unproved component.

value.rationale: Fu–Shan supplies an extremal locality-three, distance-five code but its guaranteed correction of four erasures does not describe reliability at five or six. The exact failure probabilities 16/792 and 181/924 directly quantify the first two uncertainty levels in this smallest maximal three-group member. The structural 112 inherited versus 69 genuinely new six-circuit failures distinguishes failure mechanisms and yields a useful finite benchmark for near-threshold erasure decoding; no increase in code distance or asymptotic benefit is claimed.
